description:
Job Description: 
 Analytical Mechanics Associates, Inc (AMA) is seeking a part-time intern to support the Flight Dynamics Research Facility at NASA Langley Research Center. The CAD Model Design Intern will support the Entry Systems Modeling project to develop free flight and forced oscillation model design for rapid prototype fabrication. Project activities include but are not limited to, forced oscillation and free flight tests to investigate the dynamic stability of blunt entry vehicles. The models to be tested include variations of geometries. Forced oscillation testing and free flight testing will provide static and dynamic stability data for the geometries tested as well as free flight dynamics which will serve as validation data for trajectory simulation analysis.
 Responsibilities 
 Develop models in in the form of .igs or .stp, as well as the native CAD format used for the design work
 Develop CAD models for oscillation configurations that include location of mounting interface at specified reference points,
 Design geometry to accommodate thermal inset fasteners for accurate and reliable mounting to the balance sting
 Create CAD solid models of free flight wind tunnel models using FDM 3D printing methods or similar.
 Design the models to enable a movable center of gravity
 Requirements 
 Undergraduate or Graduate student with a degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering
 Minimum of 2 years’ experience in developing CAD models or 2 semesters of relevant CAD course

description:
Are you an engineering student looking to apply your technical skills in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment? Do you enjoy solving real-world problems and working directly with global teams? Join Emerson as a Sales Engineer Co-op and gain hands-on experience supporting critical industrial applications.

This 8-month co-op is based at our global headquarters for Fisher control valves in Marshalltown, Iowa. As part of our Global Industry Sales team, you will take on meaningful technical and commercial responsibilities while building the skills to be a sales engineer. Sales Engineers serve as the primary source of factory expertise for our global sales channel. In this role, you will support real customer opportunities by combining technical knowledge, commercial insight, and strong collaboration. As a co-op, you will integrate directly into daily operations, contributing to live requests for quotation from customers, supporting project development, and developing expertise.

As a Firmware Engineer Co-op, you'll work alongside experienced firmware, electrical, and mechanical engineers to develop embedded software, automate development workflows, support hardware bring-up activities, and assist in building products from concept through validation. This role provides hands-on experience with both embedded firmware development and the tools, processes, and infrastructure that enable high-quality software delivery.

This isn't a research internship. You'll ship real tools, get real feedback, and iterate fast alongside engineers who build industrial and embedded systems for a living.
